name: agent_spawn
description: Spawn a subagent with a task: a general tool-calling loop on the runs plane (engine 'agent'). The allow-listed MCP servers become its tools, the named skills are spawn-injected into its brief, and it works until the task is done (max_turns default unlimited, hard cap 1000; the stop door is always live). Artifacts land in the run dir. Drive it by starting a run with an engine 'agent' stage: params carry task (the brief, required), mcps (the allow-list of MCP server names), skills (leaf ids to inline), inputs (a list of {name, value} entries), model (a provider/model route id) and max_turns.

task.description: The brief — what the subagent must get done. Required.

mcps.description: Allow-list of MCP server namespaces (blender, unity, ...) — the agent's tools become mcp__<server>__*. Empty or omitted = a pure text agent.

skills.description: Skill leaf ids spawn-injected into the brief as operating instructions (read at stage start).

inputs.description: The plus-box list: entries {name, value} rendered into the brief.

model.description: The brain route id "provider/model" (overrides the engine's boot-seated route).

max_turns.description: Optional turn bound (default unlimited; hard circuit breaker 1000).
